page.notes: The left strip is the cut-off outer edge of the facing page; its fragments are transcribed as notes and are partly unreadable. The worked tables are set out as lines with " | " separating cells. The catchword "¶ Schos" is at the foot right. Some digits in the tables are uncertain, notably the 2s and 5s in the second table.
